tested_scope: Constructed Bernoulli role-local repeated-monitoring traces only. This tests durable anytime-evidence bookkeeping and promotion gating; it does not establish that real optimizer comparisons satisfy the toy Bernoulli model.

public_sources.name: Ramdas, Grünwald, Vovk, and Shafer, Game-Theoretic Statistics and Safe Anytime-Valid Inference
public_sources.bound_semantics: E-processes are evidence processes designed to remain valid at stopping times, supporting continuous monitoring and optional stopping/continuation.

public_sources.name: Grünwald, de Heide, and Koolen, Safe Testing
public_sources.bound_semantics: E-value based tests support optional continuation while preserving type-I error guarantees under their stated assumptions.

public_sources.name: Safe testing practical exposition
public_sources.bound_semantics: For safe test martingale constructions, evidence can be monitored and a threshold of 1/alpha can be used for early stopping; optional stopping/continuation does not require ordinary fixed-sample peeking corrections.

source_binding_limit: Only anytime monitoring and threshold semantics are imported. The toy multiplicative factors are a precommitted likelihood-ratio construction for the fixed trace, and no broader validity claim is made beyond the stated model. External statistics software/platforms are not accepted dependencies.

qualify_stream.decision: NO_PROMOTION through look 7; QUALIFY_B at look 8

restart_stream.decision: NO_PROMOTION; restart resumed the persisted value rather than starting a new evidence process

candidate_results.reason: Qualifying B on any locally favorable look ignores the durable cumulative threshold; the fixed all-success trace is still below 20 after seven favorable looks.

candidate_results.trace: The cumulative evidence starts once at 1, counts each unique same-scope terminal comparison once, persists across restart, stays NO_PROMOTION below 20, and only qualifies B when the eighth all-success observation raises evidence to 25.62890625. Qualification remains separate from actual authority transfer.

candidate_results.reason: Resetting evidence after an unfavorable observation or restart violates G4 and changes the statistical experiment by discarding prior evidence history; the fixed restart trace therefore requires resume, not reset.
An external hosted experimentation platform is a residual execution/quota dependency and is not required by the accepted Chat-native reduction.

accepted_claim: For the exact precommitted toy traces, durable no-reset anytime evidence prevents repeated peeking from converting subthreshold favorable fluctuations into assignment promotion and survives restart without duplicate counting.
not_claimed: No claim that arbitrary e-values may be multiplied safely, no real optimizer effect estimate, no general type-I guarantee outside the stated construction, and no optimizer superiority claim.
exact_next_action_after_readback: Advance controller credit by one only after independent readback. Then precommit a non-conflicting switch-safety leaf before its public semantic read; prioritize a mechanism that addresses irreversible promotion after delayed contradictory evidence rather than another repeated-monitoring variant.
